_note: Transfers of personal data outside Saudi Arabia (PDPL Art 29; Transfer Regulation Arts 4 and 7). In production, 'accounts' transfers must each have a mechanism and a risk assessment recorded before sign-ups open, and 'generation' transfers before photos go to the video model. Record only what has actually been done: a mechanism means a signed or accepted safeguard (e.g. SDAIA standard contractual clauses signed by both sides, or an SDAIA adequacy decision for the country); riskAssessment means a completed assessment kept on file (file name and date). See docs/compliance/transfers.md.

railway.data: everything the service stores: account details, eligibility and agreement records, photos, inputs, videos, credit and purchase records, reports; technical logs
railway.location: United States (US West, California); logs in US West

resend.location: United States (all account data, logs and metadata, whatever the sending region)

fal.location: United States and other countries (not named by fal); partner-model content goes to the model's provider
